protocol.source: VLA_MUI_HUB right-16x32, first policy inference per episode
protocol.candidate_pool: four disjoint K8 folds from the common K32 seed grid
protocol.routing_sites: 8 HB layers x 10 action tokens; full 32-way softmax
protocol.outcome_blinding: head fitting/scoring functions consume only initial noise and routing; success is read only by the separate aggregation stage
protocol.head_target: within-K8 rank of late-route Hellinger centrality
protocol.head_cross_fit: complete task held out; the test fold's eight seed identities are also absent from every source-task training pool
protocol.random_baseline: exact mean success in the identical K8 candidate pool
protocol.shadow_estimand: episode-start seed-stream selection; not per-replan closed-loop control

validation.test_seed_disjointness: runtime asserted for every task/fold head

decision.reason: The held-out shadow A/B does not support route centrality or the future-route self-supervised head as a success-improving selector.
decision.next_required_test: closed-loop same-state branching with common future noise and a value-linked or causal target, once a GPU is available
